nom: Urban Veda Purifying Neem & Tea Tree Exfoliating Facial Polish

avis.texte: This products is absolutely great. makes your skin feel fresh and very cleans, leave the skin smooth and hydrated. I read a comment that it leaves oily film on the face. I do not agree. You must give it a go, really good and great a couple of times a week . My husband always uses it to.
Not only do I love the scent, but how it works. Only use this on my entire face once, more on my nose for my pores. I'll try on my neck next. Good product & will be purchasing this again!
Wow! I'm an almost 50-year old man and this product is THE one. I love it. Feels so great on the face and it smells so dang good. And my face glows! Great product in every way.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again!!
avis.texte: This product really works! I have super oily acne prone skin and its keeping it very clear. VERY EXCITING! Thank you.

I use this every other day to keep my skin fresh, its gentle enough that it doesn't irritate but strong enough that it makes a big difference. The smell of tea tree and mint is very refreshing and has a cooling effect. This is now one of my favorite products!
most face scrubs are really rough and bad for your skin barrier but this one is very gentle yet gets the job done

avis.titre: One of the best polish I have ever used.
avis.texte: Super creamy and the granules help really feel clean, this is a staple in my skincare routine. Really helped in the summer months to
I love this - it deep cleanses my pores way better than any other exfoliator I've used before, and doesn't feel super harsh.

avis.titre: I don't like that it leaves a film of oil on my face
avis.texte: It feels weird when you wash it off- like I just applied baby oil. I didn't like the feeling at all and had to wash my face after. I like the smell and the gentle scrub, but this is not good for oily skin.
I've been using this for about a week and so far so good. It has a really nice gentle exfoliation making it great for sensitive skin. My skin feels clean and breathable after using it.

avis.titre: I JUST BOUGHT FOR THE 2nd TIME!
avis.texte: I have struggled my whole life with acne, breakouts, dry/combo/oily skin (I'm 37 now) and I have tried everything under the sun - especially just a daily cleanser. My skin has never looked so amazing. Not only has my acne gone away, my skin is so much smoother and it's coloring has evened out. For the first time in my life, I am comfortable and confident going out without full makeup coverage. The exfoliating little scrubbers are just enough to leave my face feeling smooth and clean without being harsh. Somehow it moisturizes while removing dirt, oil and makeup. I use it twice a day - morning and night- and now I am looking at their face lotions and oils to add to my routine!
This stuff is SO GOOD. Creamy texture with lots of scrubby bits and keeps me from getting breakouts. Can't live without this stuff at this point, I've already repurchased twice.

This product makes my skin look and feel amazing. I only discovered it after being given testers back in February and I've been hooked ever since. My skin looks brighter and my really oily skin looks more dewy now. I would definitely recommend.

This is by far one of the best exfoliators I've used, there is the perfect amount of exfoliating beads and love that they are environmentally friendly. Really helped with my congested skin, left my skin feeling really clear!

avis.titre: My skin looks blemish free, this is such a good product
avis.texte: I discovered these purely by accident came as a present from a friend. My skin looks blemish free, this is such a good product one of the best I have used in my life, it's also inexpensive lasts me about 2-3 months as a little goes a long way. Very cost effective not abrasive on the skin. In fact it does what it says on the tin, it makes your skin look radiant.

Lovely smell!!! The scrub is really tiny but thorough. What is a big pro for me. It does what it needs to do and gives your skin that beautiful clean and fresh feeling. Even considering to buy the rest of this product line. I just can't get over the smell!

avis.titre: Perfect scrub makes face feel clean
avis.texte: Not too harsh on skin. Leaves it feeling clean and smooth. Leave on face for a minute before rinsing.
Great product - love the mint which is refreshing and it isn't drying even for my dryish skin!
I don't need to say a lot of words. This will be forever my fave. Love it. Refreshing and 'delicious' ❤
